layman_headline: Market is ripping higher but everything looks stretched — time to manage what we have, not chase.
layman_explanation: The entire crypto market just had a massive week — Bitcoin is up 23%, Ethereum 29%, and many altcoins are up 40-90%. Our Solana position is up 8.4% and getting close to our $100 profit target. Our XRP position is slightly underwater at -4.5% despite XRP being one of the best performers this week, meaning we entered near a local high. Every swing candidate on the watchlist has already moved dramatically and most are overbought, making new entries very risky right now.
layman_action: Don't buy anything new right now. Let the SOL trade ride toward the $100 target. Watch XRP closely — if it drops below $1.30, cut it. Wait for a market pullback to find better entries.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates are deeply extended: PUMP RSI 86 with +93% 7d, LIT RSI 75 with +42% 7d, STX +87% 7d, ZRO +60% 7d. Entering any of these after such parabolic moves violates swing trading discipline — the risk/reward is inverted. Fear & Greed at 66 (down from 71 yesterday) suggests the greed impulse may be cooling. BTC dominance at 59.3% continues to suppress alt outperformance potential. The best action is to manage existing positions: SOL is within 6% of its $100 exit target and should be held. XRP at -4.5% is concerning given XRP's massive 50% weekly move — our entry was poorly timed near a local top, and the stop at $1.30 provides 13% downside protection. No new position offers a clean setup with definable risk.
risk_factors: Market-wide pullback after a historic weekly rally could hit both SOL and XRP hard simultaneously
BTC dominance at 59.3% means capital is concentrating in Bitcoin, creating headwinds for alt positions
XRP entered near a local high and the 50% weekly move may mean significant retracement ahead
watch_list: SOL price action near $100 psychological resistance — take profit if it touches or exceeds target
XRP behavior relative to $1.30 stop-loss — any daily close below $1.40 warrants heightened attention
Fear & Greed index trajectory — a drop below 55 would signal the rally is losing steam and pullback entries may emerge
market_context: The crypto market just experienced a massive squeeze-led rally with BTC up 23% and most alts up 25-90% in a single week. This kind of move typically leads to a consolidation or pullback phase — not the time to chase.
context_banner: After an explosive weekly rally, discipline demands patience: manage winners, protect capital, and wait for the market to cool before deploying new capital.

key_signals.description: All swing candidates show overbought or extremely extended conditions (PUMP RSI 86, LIT RSI 75, MON RSI 62 with +41% 7d), making new entries high-risk.
Fear & Greed at 66 (Greed) but declining from yesterday's 71, suggesting momentum may be peaking after the massive weekly rally.
Bitcoin and Ether bears got 'decimated' in a squeeze-led rally — confirming the move was short-squeeze driven, which often exhausts quickly.
Ray Dalio recommending 'a bit' of Bitcoin amid debt crisis concerns provides a macro tailwind, but BTC at $77K has already priced in significant optimism.
Massive volumes across the board (BTC $27B, ETH $13B, XRP $5.9B) confirm the rally is real but also suggest climactic buying that often precedes consolidation.
